candidate.answerReason: Every segment from P to a point on l has length at least the perpendicular distance, 3 cm. Therefore PQ cannot be 2 cm.

methods.label: Use the shortest perpendicular segment
methods.explanation: Among the segments connecting a point outside a line to points on the line, the perpendicular segment is the shortest, so \(PQ\) cannot be less than \(3\) cm.
methods.levelReason: Directly applies the Grade 7 shortest-perpendicular-segment fact.
